policy: All 64 native families are mapped; selectors may share recipes. The offline gate checks coverage and local references. Upstream source hashes identify the reviewed inputs; visual equivalence requires host inspection and is not established by these runtime tests. Browser-only selectors, DOM geometry, hover and keyboard behavior are not imported.
